item.title: Old Estate Agent signs along Sidcup High Street, 19th August
item.description:
Estate Agents are failing to remove old 'for sale' or 'to let' signs along the length of the High St. which are unsightly and detract from the street scene. Google photos street view, for example, shows a sign above S&G News and Off License (102 Sidcup High St.) in place since 2008! Bexley Council needs to write to Agents to remind them of the legislation and inform them of remedial action required.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 96-98, High Street, Longlands, Sidcup, Greater London
